summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Secure XML Messaging System MVP. All core features working correctly including authentication, message encryption/signing, XML validation, and frontend-backend integration.

fixed_issues.issue: Missing lxml and xmlschema dependencies in requirements.txt
fixed_issues.fix: Added lxml>=4.9.0 and xmlschema>=2.5.0 to requirements.txt
fixed_issues.impact: Backend was failing to start due to missing XML processing libraries

fixed_issues.issue: XSD schema string contained HTML entities instead of proper XML
fixed_issues.fix: Replaced < and > with < and > in XSD_SCHEMA_STR
fixed_issues.impact: XML schema validation was failing during startup

passed_tests: Login flow with httpOnly cookie using demo user alice/alice123
Login flow with demo user bob/bob123
Compose and send message to bob with XML preview generation
Logout and login as bob shows inbox with signature_valid: true
Decrypt inbox message and verify plaintext matches sent body
Download XSD from /api/messages/schema returns valid XML
Backend /api/status create and list endpoints work correctly
Route prefix '/api' usage is correct throughout the application
All primary interactive elements have data-testid attributes
Message encryption using AES-256-CBC works correctly
Message signing using RSA-SHA256 works correctly
JWT authentication with httpOnly cookies works correctly
XML envelope structure follows SOAP-style format
MongoDB integration for user and message storage works correctly
action_item_for_E1: No action items required. All features are working correctly. The system successfully implements secure XML messaging with AES-256-CBC encryption, RSA-SHA256 signatures, XSD validation, and proper authentication flow.
